title: "Search strategy"

This page records the search, as PRISMA-S requires [@rethlefsen2021]. The counts are the records each database returned before deduplication. [01-deduplication](../analysis/01-deduplication.ipynb) writes the identification counts for the flow diagram from the exports in `data/raw/search_exports/` once the exports are in.

## Query

One query runs in Scopus, Web of Science, and PubMed. It searches titles and abstracts for a form of *share* within five words of *data*, together with a word beginning *research* or *scienti*. In Scopus and Web of Science the search also covers author keywords. It covers sources published from 2015 to 2025 in English and French and applies no document type filter. Development and testing, below, gives how we chose it and how well it performs.

| Database | Records |
|:--|--:|
| PubMed | 9,194 |
| Scopus | 31,683 |
| Web of Science | 22,763 |
| **Total** | **63,640** |

: Records the query returned on 23 November 2026 through each database's API, before deduplication. Matched on DOI, or on title and year, they come to 34,305. The Web of Science count omits the language limit, which its API rejects beside a proximity search. {#tbl-records}

Platforms and search dates for the exports are to be added.

## Development and testing

**Method.** We tested candidate queries against known relevant sources, following the development and validation set approach of @hausner2012. The known sources are the 76 sources included by @chawinga2019 that meet this review's criteria apart from year. We rebuilt their list from the paper with a script, and checked each source against the criteria with a local language model. Sources published 2007 to 2014 form the development set: 45 sources, 35 of them indexed in at least one database. Sources published from 2015 form the test set: 31 sources, 25 indexed, held out while we chose the title query. The revision to the revised query counted test sources too, so the test result below is not independent of that choice.

We ran each candidate in PubMed, Scopus and Web of Science and recorded two counts: the records it returns for 2015 to 2025 in English or French, and the development and test sources it finds by DOI or PMID. Every measurement here can be checked or rerun in the [search development notebook](../analysis/00_search-development/00-search-development.ipynb), which holds each run with its code and files.

**Candidates compared.**

| Query, titles and abstracts | PubMed | Scopus | Web of Science |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| *share* within 5 words of *data* | 18,840 | 82,924 | 62,225 |
| *share* within 5 words of *"research data"* | 1,536 · 15 | 743 · 41 | 589 · 37 |
| *share* within 5 words of *data* AND *research\** | 8,615 · 5 | 29,912 · 8 | 21,330 · 8 |
| ***share* within 5 words of *data* AND (*research\** OR *scienti\**) (the query)** | **9,194 · 3** | **31,683 · 3** | **22,763 · 5** |
| *share* within 5 words of *data* AND (*research\** OR *scientific* OR *scientist\** OR *trial\** OR *cohort\**) | 10,511 · 1 | 33,481 · 3 | 24,361 · 3 |
| *share* within 5 words of *data* AND (*research\** OR *scientific* OR *scientist\** OR *study* OR *studies* OR *trial\** OR *cohort\**) | 14,396 · 1 | 49,304 · 2 | 37,258 · 3 |

: Records for 2015 to 2025, and the development and test sources each query loses against *share* within 5 words of *data*. {#tbl-candidates tbl-colwidths="[52,16,16,16]"}

Runs 21 and 22 hold these measurements, and runs 23 to 25 the tests of a clause excluding computing words, which also excluded eligible records.

**Results.**

- **Test set:** the query finds 20 of the 25 indexed test sources, a relative recall of 0.80 (95% interval 0.61 to 0.91). That is 8 of 11 in PubMed, 19 of 23 in Scopus and 12 of 18 in Web of Science (run 26).
- **What it misses:** five indexed test sources. Chiware and Mathe (2016), Specht et al. (2015) and Wittenberg and Elings (2017) concern research data management, Watson (2015) concerns open science, and Houtkoop et al. (2018) has no word beginning *research* or *scienti* in the fields the databases search.

**Limits.**

- The development result is in-sample, because we chose the query to find as many development sources as possible. Only the test result estimates recall.
- The test set is small and dates from 2015 to 2018, so recall for sources from 2019 to 2025 is untested.
- The revised query was chosen partly on the test sources, so 20 of 25 overstates its recall on sources it has not seen.
- Admitting all source types from fields outside health research came after the first test result. It raised the test sources in scope from 10 to 25.

**Peer review.** A McGill health sciences librarian reviewed the search approach on 27 October 2026.

## Search strings

### Generic query

```text
Title/abstract: share* NEAR/5 data
AND
Title/abstract: research* OR scienti*

Limits: published 2015 to 2025; English or French
```

### PubMed

PubMed's proximity search takes no truncation, so the string writes out four forms of *share*.

```text
(
  ("sharing data"[tiab:~5] OR "shared data"[tiab:~5] OR "share data"[tiab:~5] OR "shares data"[tiab:~5])
  AND (research*[tiab] OR scienti*[tiab])
)
AND 2015:2025[dp]
AND (english[la] OR french[la])
```

### Scopus

```text
TITLE-ABS-KEY ( shar* W/5 data )
AND TITLE-ABS-KEY ( research* OR scienti* )
AND PUBYEAR > 2014 AND PUBYEAR < 2026
AND LANGUAGE ( english OR french )
```

### Web of Science

```text
TS=( shar* NEAR/5 data )
AND TS=( research* OR scienti* )
AND PY=(2015-2025)
AND LA=(English OR French)
```

## Export file names

Name each export `<database>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.<ext>`, for example `scopus_2026-11-18.ris`. The date is the search date. Supported formats are RIS and CSV. See the README in `data/raw/search_exports/`.
